decisions.reason: Changing the editing guide from a Google Doc to a Loom recording does not alter the website handoff destination or artifact.
The accepted recording format is unrelated to the Basic Webflow hosting tier and cost-selection rule.
The editing guide format does not change the hero headline or body copy.
The Loom recording decision does not change the hero image, depicted controls, gallery, or mobile-phone presentation.
Here Loom denotes the instruction-recording format, not a change to the existing Loom website visual-style reference.
The recording format does not affect the dealer login button placement or destination URL.
The editing guide format does not alter early-access navigation or its contact-page destination.
The recording format does not change contact-form submission recipients or lead delivery.
The editing guide artifact format does not alter the landing page's content composition, image quantity, or screenshot policy.
